title: Bounded-below quasi-coherent algebra-derived objects detected on underlying cohomology
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A$ a quasi-coherent commutative $\mathcal O_Y$-algebra, and $E$ an object of $D(A)$ [def-pc-derived-category-qcoh-algebra]. If its derived restriction of scalars has quasi-coherent cohomology [def-pc-derived-category] and is bounded below, then $E$ belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(A)$ [def-pc-derived-category-qcoh-algebra].

source.place: Tags 0BV0, 0BV1 and 0AX2, exact restriction of algebra scalars

proof.text: Use the finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation instances for scalar restriction from def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module. Choose the canonical Q-preimage representative of E. Combine the Q factorization isomorphisms and the short-complex mapHomologyIso to identify restricted cohomology with cohomology of derived restriction.

source.place: Tags 0BV0, 0BV1 and 0AX2, exact restriction of algebra scalars

proof.text: Transport quasi-coherence through this isomorphism. For each degree below the underlying bound, the restricted cohomology object is zero. Evaluating its identity-equals-zero equation gives the same equation on the algebra cohomology, since restriction of scalars leaves the underlying maps unchanged. Thus the algebra cohomology is zero and both defining clauses of the claimed membership hold.
